video.title: Why Your A Beat B
video.script: You ran an A/B test. Variant A crushed variant B. But here's the problem: you don't actually know why. Was it the subject line? The day you sent it? The specific people who got each version? Reply Lift cuts through the noise. It shows you which variable caused the lift, not just that it happened. Test smarter, iterate faster.
